scheme_name: Moovalur Ramamirtham Ammaiyar Ninaivu Marriage Assistance Scheme - II
other_conditions: Bride must be a degree holder from a regular college, distance education or government recognized open university, or a diploma holder from institutions recognized by the Directorate of Technical Education, Government of Tamil Nadu
Only one girl per family is eligible
Application must be submitted within 40 days before the marriage (up to one day before in exceptional circumstances)
Benefit will be given in the name of the bride's mother or father, or to the bride if the parents are deceased
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹50,000 and a 4 gm 22‑carat gold coin (one sovereign) for the bride.
documents_required: Copies of all mandatory documents (self‑attested if required)
